title: Two Children on Lawn at Busch Gardens, 1971 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage snapshot capturing two young children relaxing on a sunny grass hill during an April 1971 outing to Busch Gardens. A young girl reclines on her stomach while a boy sits beside her. In the background, visitors stroll across a curved footbridge over a lagoon where tall birds wade along the bank, capturing the casual warmth of American family road trips and theme park tourism in the early 1970s.
